text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Estate Duty (Chua Siew Cheng, Deceased) (Remission) Order 2004.
2. The sum of $10,056.88 payable under the Act on the share in the Estate of Wang Wen Han, Deceased, passing on the death of Chua Siew Cheng on 17th January 1998 is hereby remitted.
